content: The most recent UEFA Champions League final was held on June 1, 2024, at Wembley Stadium in London. Real Madrid defeated Borussia Dortmund 2–0 to win their 15th Champions League title. Goals were scored by Dani Carvajal and Vinícius Júnior.
